selectionReason: The issue #60 rule selects up to ten absent Joyo kanji in frozen source-row order, with one support-word article per selected kanji. A qualifying support word uses JMdict news1, ichi1, spec1, or gai1; news2/spec2 do not qualify. The selected rows 38, 40, 41, 43, 46, 47, 50, 51, 55, and 60 are the first ten remaining Joyo rows after B156. Every support word's other kanji already has a card or is in this batch. Among considered alternatives, JMdict entries 1340880 (俊英), 1272630 (侯), 1272650 (侯爵), and 1588830 (王侯) carry only news2/spec2 and do not qualify; entry 1405300 (俗語) carries news2 plus ichi1 and qualifies via ichi1. 諸侯 is the sole priority-tag exception: JMdict entry 1344250 has no qualifying priority tag; 侯補 is a search-only spelling of 候補 (1272730), and 候補 does not use 侯. The exception is explicit and must receive row-specific independent review.

supportMappings.exceptionReason: No candidate using 侯 carries news1, ichi1, spec1, or gai1. 侯爵 and 王侯 carry only news2/spec2; 侯補 is search-only and 候補 uses 候. Keep this explicit untagged exception for independent review.
